result.question: How much did Nvidia spend on research and development in its latest fiscal year (FY2026)?
result.answer: Nvidia spent $18,497 million (approximately $18.5 billion) on research and development in fiscal year 2026, the 52-week year ended January 25, 2026 [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2026-01-25]. This represented 8.6% of total revenue for the year [0001045810-26-000021:item-7-p007].
